summary: Validated Reporte Maestro v3: full-page preview PNG, section_order backend field, frontend auto-preview debounce (800ms), auto toggle ON/OFF, drag-and-drop reorder, manual preview buttons, and PDF generation with custom section order. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass (full-page PNG > 500KB, section_order respected in PDF output verified via pypdf, section_order ignores unknown/disabled sections). Frontend: all 13 scenarios from the request pass end-to-end. Drag & drop with Playwright's drag_to works natively against the HTML5 handlers in MasterReportModal; payload sent to /preview and /generate contains the user-reordered section_order. Initial auto-preview fires correctly; debounce is observed (no call at 300ms, 1 call after 1.8s post-edit). Auto toggle text switches between 'Auto · ON' / 'Auto · OFF' and OFF truly suppresses auto-fires.
critical_code_review_comments: master_report.py is still ~1136 lines. Splitting (models, styles, html_builder, routes) would help maintainability.
Line 715-719 in master_report.py: the sort key uses an inline 'index if in DEFAULT_ORDER else 9999' that is a bit convoluted but works; consider extracting to a helper with a test comment.

MasterReportModal.js: debounceRef is cleared on unmount only for the last effect; multiple independent debounces are not a problem today because there is a single effect, but future additions should preserve this discipline.
Drag & drop uses native HTML5 events — no accessibility (keyboard) fallback. Not blocking but worth noting for a future a11y pass.
seed_data_creation: none; uses first training plan of test user
context_for_next_testing_agent: Master Report modal tabs are: mr-tab-design, mr-tab-cover, mr-tab-content, mr-tab-preview (NOT mr-tab-style). Style buttons live inside the Design tab as mr-style-{id}. Preview canvas has data-testid='mr-preview-canvas' with overflow-y:auto and max-height:640px. Order list is data-testid='mr-order-list' with items mr-order-item-{sid} (draggable=true). Debounce is 800ms; use wait_for_timeout(>=1500) after edits to catch auto-preview. Manual preview: mr-preview-btn (header) and mr-quick-preview-btn (footer). PDF: mr-generate-btn triggers a download with toast 'Reporte Maestro descargado'.
rca of the issue: n/a — all requested v3 features work correctly on both backend and frontend.
